about_history_p1: The Idrizovo Correctional Institution is the largest prison facility in the Republic of North Macedonia. It is located about 10 kilometers southeast of Skopje and serves as the central institution for serving prison sentences.
about_history_p2: The history of KPD Idrizovo begins during the Second World War, when a military camp was built by the Bulgarian occupying army. Immediately after the end of the war, it continued to operate as a prison-work colony, where inmates were engaged in agricultural and construction work. Over time, the institution expanded and became the largest prison in the country.
about_history_p3: This regulation governs the organization and work of the Correctional Institution - KPD Idrizovo - with the open unit in Veles (hereinafter: the Institution), and defines the internal organization, the types of organizational units and their scope of work, management within the Institution and organizational units, and the planning and execution of tasks and duties in the institution.
